Subject: nuclear physics | ID: 58113

Proof

Step 3. Applying the Schatten interpolation theorem to \(U_{01320013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via Laplace interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
